'Football Athletic Club Pyrgos 1968') is a Greek [[association football|football]] [[Football club (association football)|club]] based in [[Pyrgos, Elis|Pyrgos]]. The club operates men's and women's football departments, as well as a futsal section. In 2025, Thyella Katarrachiou Pyrgos merged with PAS Pyrgos 2023 and was renamed PAS Pyrgos 1968, adopting [[red]] and [[white]] as its official colors and the torch—the historic emblem of [[Paniliakos F.C.|Paniliakos]]—as its crest.{{cite web |url=https://www.iliaoikonomia.gr/p-a-s-pyrgos-1968-apofasistike-os-neo-onoma-tis-thyellas-me-aporrofisi-kai-tou-proin-p-a-s/ |title=“Π.Α.Σ. Πύργος 1968” αποφασίστηκε ως νέο όνομα της Θύελλας (με απορρόφηση και του πρώην Π.Α.Σ.) |website=iliaoikonomia.gr |language=el}} Since the 2026–27 season, the men's football section competes in [[Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]], the second tier of the Greek football league system, under the corporate name PAS Pyrgos 1968 S.A. and the trading name Pyrgos AFC.{{cite web |url=https://publicity.businessportal.gr/company/195131325000 |title=ΓΕΜΗ :: Υπηρεσίες Δημοσιότητας |website=publicity.businessportal.gr |access-date=25 July 2026 |language=el}} The club plays its home matches at the [[Pyrgos Stadium]], which has a capacity of 6,750."}}
